checks.detail: No verified message to tenant and no verified close_ticket.tenant_confirmation

items.reasoning: The agent logged the landlord's decision as 'own_contractor' (A1). It asked the landlord to confirm 'you are paying Riverside Services directly, so we do not expect an invoice', and plans to 'close without payment'. Nothing is routed to agency accounts.
items.evidence: A1 record_landlord_decision own_contractor; A2 question on direct payment

items.reasoning: The agent judged the event 042 call summary 'too vague to treat as completion evidence'. Instead of assuming, it asked the landlord in writing to confirm the communal garden and hedge works were finished, 'including the tree trimming'.
items.evidence: A2 REQ-101: 'confirm in writing that Freya... has finished the communal garden and hedge works, including the tree trimming'

items.reasoning: Completion was not confirmed in writing, so the agent did not close. The ticket stays on hold, a follow-up is set for 15 Dec (4 days out) with a specific purpose (FUP-102), and the ask to the landlord is specific.

No message went to the tenant at Flat 26, and the agent did not mention Flat 44 at all. It only plans to tell the tenant after confirmation. No 'where you stand' update was sent, even though updates were promised in events 025 and 031.
items.evidence: No tenant-facing action in ledger; 'Tell the tenant the works are done once confirmed' listed as remaining work

items.reasoning: The agent waits with a 15 Dec review date while the landlord confirms both completion and direct payment. This matches the alternative exactly.
The invoice arrangement was confirmed with the landlord, not the contractor, and nothing was routed to the agency.
items.evidence: A2 to Rowan (landlord): 'so we do not expect an invoice'

items.reasoning: The pigeon nest from event 037 is not mentioned anywhere in the agent's files. The agent asks about tree trimming but makes no link to the nest.
The agent recorded the own-contractor decision but did not flag that events 034/035 ('Maintenance provider assigned') conflict with this. It also did not record that no agency provider was used.

No closing note was written, but the case-state record is factual: it names who is doing the work (Riverside/Freya), notes the payment route is still to be confirmed, and states the evidence is only a vague call with nothing in writing. It does not overclaim completion.
items.evidence: case_state: 'A 11 Dec call suggests the works are done, but nothing is confirmed in writing.'

items.reasoning: The agent asked for no invoice to the agency. It explicitly said it does not expect one.
No tenant messages were sent, and nothing anywhere claims an agency provider did the work.
No payment actions appear in the ledger.
There was no payment approval and no invoice chase for the agency to pay.

grades.overall_note: The agent correctly saw this as a landlord-pays-direct job. It held back from closing until completion was confirmed and set a short follow-up with a specific ask, which is more cautious than what really happened but is an acceptable path. It sent no tenant update and did not pick up the pigeon nest or the event 034/035 provider-assigned discrepancy.

items.text: Recognises that the works were quoted, instructed and are being paid for by the landlord through his own contractor (Riverside Services), so no invoice is chased for the agency to pay and no payment is approved or held through the agency.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Confirms completion before closing: uses the call with the contractor (event 042) and, if it does not clearly cover every reported item (weeds, hedge, side land, tree), asks the contractor or landlord to confirm rather than assuming.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Once completion is confirmed, closes the request as completed without payment; if it is not yet confirmed, holds with a short review date and a specific ask.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Updates the tenants who reported the problem (Flat 26, and Flat 44 per event 023) that the garden works are done or where they stand, since they were promised updates (events 025 and 031).
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Waiting with a review date while the landlord is asked to confirm the job is finished to his satisfaction and that he is settling the contractor directly.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent took this alternative path.

items.text: Confirming the invoice arrangement with the landlord rather than the contractor, as long as nothing is routed to the agency's accounts.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent took this alternative path.

items.text: Notes the nesting pigeons (event 037) and does not press for the tree work to be forced while a nest may still be active; checks that part was finished only once the nest had gone.
